metadata.title: Gymtrack Official Skills Gap Analysis and Comprehensive Curriculum

gapAnalysis.name: Handstand Flatback onto Mat Stack
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Accelerated board hurdle into tight handstand with heel drive, falling straight to flat back on 32" mat stack.

steps: Run with forward acceleration and hurdle onto the springboard with feet together and arms swinging back to front.
Punch the board explosively, punching arms up through ears into a 45° entry toward the mat stack.
Hit a vertical handstand momentarily on the front edge of the mat stack with locked elbows and tight ribs.
Hollow down and drop flat onto the back with chin tucked, maintaining complete body alignment.
commonFaults: Arching through lower back on impact

videoTutorial.title: Handstand Flat Back Vault Technique & Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Run & Hurdle onto Springboard to Straight Jump
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Consistent accelerated sprint, low hurdle onto sweet spot of the board, and explosive vertical straight jump with stuck landing.

steps: Sprint 40-50 feet with upright sprinting mechanics and high knees, accelerating progressively.
Execute a low, forward-driven hurdle step off one foot without elevating excessively.
Punch both balls of feet simultaneously on the sweet spot (front third) of the springboard.
Drive arms straight up by ears, soaring into a tight hollow straight jump, and stick the landing on 8" mat.
commonFaults: Jumping too high into the board
prerequisites: Straight jump stick on floor line

videoTutorial.title: How to Run and Hurdle onto the Springboard | Vault Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Glide Swing with Extension
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Jump from mat into piked glide swing forward, full body extension with toes pointing at end of swing, and swing back.

steps: Stand arm distance behind low bar, jump forward to catch bar with overhand grip.
Pike legs smoothly at hips with straight knees, sliding toes just inches off the floor mat.
At peak forward swing, open shoulders and extend hips fully into an open hollow body line.
Pull heels and hips back toward bar on backswing with straight arms engaged.
keyCoachingCues: Shoot toes forward at full extension
commonFaults: Failing to extend at forward peak

videoTutorial.title: How to Master the Glide Swing on Bars | Key Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Pullover to Front Support
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Chin-up pull, dynamic leg kick over low bar, shifting wrists into locked front support.

steps: Hang with overgrip, initiate with a strong flexed-arm chin pull bringing chin over bar.
Drive knees or straight legs overhead, pulling hips tight against the bar.
Rotate hips over the bar while shifting wrists from hang to front support position.
Push tall into locked front support with shoulders over bar and legs tight.

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Pullover on Bars | Gymnastics Step by Step

gapAnalysis.name: Cast to 30°-45° (Hips Clear of Bar)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: From front support, round into hollow, dip shoulders and drive hips upward at least 30°-45° with straight arms.

steps: Begin in locked front support with straight arms and rounded upper back.
Bend slightly at the hips to load momentum while keeping arms locked straight.
Explosively drive toes and heels backward and upward while pressing downward with hands.
Reach a minimum 30° angle with hips clear of the bar before returning softly.
commonFaults: Arching back instead of hollow cast

videoTutorial.title: How to Cast on Uneven Bars | Level 3 & Silver Cast Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Back Hip Circle
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Cast off bar, fall backward rotating around the bar with hips glued to bar, returning to front support.

steps: Perform a preliminary cast to clear hips from bar.
As body returns, glue thighs/hips to the bar with head neutral and body straight.
Drop backward like a statue, using momentum to rotate 360° around the bar.
Shift wrists dynamically on top to finish in tall front support.

videoTutorial.title: How to do a Back Hip Circle | Step-by-Step Gymnastics Tutorial

gapAnalysis.name: Undershoot Dismount (Sole Circle / Cast Prep)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Cast, drop into hollow under the bar, shoot toes upward and outward, releasing bar to a stuck landing.

steps: Execute a cast to 30°, then drop into an undershoot under the bar keeping hips close.
Maintain eye contact with feet as body swings forward under the bar.
Shoot toes up toward ceiling and release bar with both hands simultaneously.
Land softly in demi-plié with chest upright and stick without stepping.

videoTutorial.title: Undershoot Dismount Tutorial | Level 3 Uneven Bars

gapAnalysis.name: Jump to Front Support Mount on Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: From springboard or mat, jump with hands on beam to straight-arm front support with tight legs and pointed toes.

steps: Place hands flat on beam shoulder-width apart, fingers wrapping sides.
Punch springboard and push down through palms to elevate hips above beam.
Extend shoulders over hands in locked front support with legs glued together.
Swing right leg over beam into straddle or squat position with graceful posture.
keyCoachingCues: Eyes focused on far end of beam
prerequisites: Front support hold on floor bar

videoTutorial.title: Beam Mounts for Beginners & Silver Level

gapAnalysis.name: Cross Handstand on Beam (Min 45° to Vertical)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Lunge on beam, place hands thumb-to-thumb, kick into tight cross handstand, and step down into balanced lunge.

steps: Start in deep beam lunge with arms by ears and torso aligned with front leg.
Reach far out, placing thumbs touching across the beam with fingers wrapped around sides.
Kick back leg up while levering body into a vertical or minimum 45° cross handstand.
Step down with dominant foot first into a clean beam lunge, arms finished in crown.
commonFaults: Crooked hand placement causing beam slip

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Handstand on Beam | Safe Drills & Confidence

gapAnalysis.name: Cartwheel on Balance Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Lunge on beam, place hand-hand in line, cartwheel in vertical plane, and land foot-foot in balanced lunge.

steps: Stand in tall lunge on beam, sight the target spot 2 feet in front of toes.
Lever down placing lead hand turned inward, follow with second hand directly along center line.
Kick back leg strongly over top, passing through a vertical straddle plane with straight legs.
Land first foot on center line, immediately followed by second foot in a steady lunge.
keyCoachingCues: Keep shoulders in line of beam
commonFaults: Missing center line with second hand
Piking hips out of beam plane

videoTutorial.title: Cartwheel on Beam Tutorial | Step by Step Breakdown

gapAnalysis.name: Split Jump (60°-90° Split) on Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: From beam stand, plie and spring straight up, splitting legs equally to 90° separation and landing safely on beam.

steps: Stand with one foot slightly in front of the other, knees relaxed.
Plie through both feet and jump straight upward with arms swinging into side-middle or crown.
Split front and back leg simultaneously to at least 90° separation with pointed toes.
Pull legs together quickly on descent to land front-foot back-foot with soft knees.
commonFaults: Uneven leg split (front leg high, back leg low)

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Split Jump on Beam | Tips for Balance & Height

gapAnalysis.name: 1/2 Pivot Turn on One Foot (Beam)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Step onto relevé on one foot, rotate 180° smoothly on ball of foot with high posture, and step down.

steps: Step forward onto the ball of one foot in high relevé, arms in first or fifth position.
Spot a focal point at opposite end of the beam to lock balance.
Turn head and shoulders 180° while pivoting cleanly on ball of foot.
Finish in locked relevé before lowering heel into preparation for next skill.

videoTutorial.title: Beam Pivot Turns Tutorial | Perfect Balance in Relevé

gapAnalysis.name: Round-off Dismount off End of Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Lunge toward end of beam, round-off with 1/4 turn, snap down off beam onto 8" landing mat and stick.

steps: Lunge along beam line approaching the dismount end with confident momentum.
Place hands in line near the end of the beam, kicking legs over with aggressive snap.
Push off beam with hands, snapping legs together before passing end of beam.
Land facing beam on landing mat, absorbing impact in demi-plié with arms presented.
keyCoachingCues: Drive the hurdle along center line
commonFaults: Looking down at hands and under-rotating

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Round Off Dismount on Beam

gapAnalysis.name: Round-off Rebound
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Hurdle into powerful 1/2 turn round-off with strong hand repulsion, snapping down to high vertical rebound.

steps: Take a 3-step run into a long, low hurdle with chest upright.
Reach hands down in a T-shape line, kicking back leg overhead into 1/2 twist.
Block aggressively through shoulders, snapping feet together through hollow body.
Rebound straight up out of punch with arms by ears, sticking clean on landing.

videoTutorial.title: Round-Off Rebound Technique & Common Mistakes

gapAnalysis.name: Handstand to Bridge Kickover
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Controlled vertical handstand, soft step down into bridge, followed by immediate split kickover to lunge.

steps: Lunge forward into a vertical handstand with shoulders open and toes pointed.
Lower lead foot softly to mat into bridge while pushing shoulders open over hands.
Without pausing, push off floor through supporting foot and drive lead leg overhead in split.
Pass through handstand back to a tall finish lunge.
keyCoachingCues: Push shoulders over wrists in bridge
commonFaults: Stuck in bridge unable to kickover

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Handstand to Bridge Kickover Tutorial

gapAnalysis.name: Back Extension Roll to Push-up / Handstand
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Straight arm backward roll with fast hip extension, pushing up through handstand or push-up hollow.

steps: Stand tall, roll back with straight legs and hands positioned next to ears palms-up.
As hips pass over head, push explosively through palms while extending hips fully.
Lock arms and legs straight, passing through a high push-up or handstand angle.
Step down into balanced finish with chest high.
commonFaults: Slow hand push causing head strain

videoTutorial.title: Back Extension Roll Tutorial | Clean Form & Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Split Leap (90° Separation) on Floor
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Step-chassé into grand jeté split leap with minimum 90° split angle, straight knees, and pointed toes.

steps: Take a continuous step or chassé with upright carriage and pointed feet.
Brush lead foot forward through low battement, exploding off trailing leg.
Achieve minimum 90° leg split at the peak of elevation with chest held tall.
Land softly in plie on front foot and step out with elegance.

videoTutorial.title: How to Get Better Split Leaps | Drills for 180 and Height

gapAnalysis.name: 1/1 Full Turn on One Foot (Floor)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Preparation step into high relevé, complete 360° turn on single support leg with heel high off floor.

steps: Step forward into preparation plie, arms curved in first position.
Rise sharply onto high relevé on supporting foot, drawing free foot into passé at ankle or knee.
Spot a fixed target on wall, whip head around 360° to lock landing spot.
Finish with control on relevé before lowering heel gracefully.

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Full Turn in Gymnastics & Dance | Form & Spotting

gapAnalysis.name: Front Handspring over Vault Table
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Full run, punch springboard, pre-flight onto vault table, shoulder repulsion into post-flight, and stuck feet landing.

steps: Sprint with maximum velocity down the 60-foot runway without stuttering.
Hurdle onto the springboard with arms driving backward to forward.
Hit board and punch into a straight pre-flight body angle of ~40° to the table.
Block explosively through shoulders on contact with the table and fly into stuck landing.
commonFaults: Piking or arching on the table

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Front Handspring Vault | Technique Breakdown

gapAnalysis.name: Half-On Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Twist Entry)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Board punch with 1/4 to 1/2 twist onto vault table or mat stack, setting foundation for Tsukahara & Yurchenko family.

steps: Hurdle onto springboard with rapid arm drive.
Punch board and initiate 1/4 to 1/2 turn from hips and core during pre-flight.
Place hands staggered/turned on table to repel off in sideways-to-backward alignment.
Land on feet or back onto mat stack with body rigid.
keyCoachingCues: Twist from the core, not arms
commonFaults: Twisting too early before leaving board

videoTutorial.title: Tsukahara & Half-On Vault Drills for Level 5 and Gold

gapAnalysis.name: Glide Kip on Low Bar
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Full extension glide swing forward, toes-to-bar pull on backswing, shift wrists and shoot into front support.

steps: Jump from mat into a long, powerful glide swing with legs straight and toes off floor.
Extend fully at forward peak, opening chest and hips into hollow body.
On backswing, pull toes rapidly to the bar while keeping arms straight.
Slide shins up the bar, shift wrists aggressively over bar and press tall into front support.
keyCoachingCues: Big open glide at the front
Toes to bar fast on return
commonFaults: Bending elbows when pulling toes up

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Kip on Uneven Bars | The Ultimate Coaching Guide

gapAnalysis.name: Cast to Horizontal (Min Above 0°)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: From front support, dip shoulders slightly and cast explosively to horizontal or higher with straight arms and locked body.

steps: Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded hollow upper body.
Load with a slight hip drop without bending elbows.
Press downward with palms while driving heels and toes upward past horizontal.
Hit horizontal line with toes pointed and return smoothly to bar.

videoTutorial.title: How to Cast to Horizontal and Handstand | Bars Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Clear Hip Circle to Horizontal (Back Free Hip)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Cast, drop backward maintaining gap between hips and bar, rotate around bar and shoot clear of bar to horizontal.

steps: Cast to horizontal, drop backward keeping straight arms pushing bar down.
Do not let hips rest on the bar; maintain hollow curve 2-4 inches off bar.
Rotate under bar and pull bar into hips momentarily, then push bar away.
Shoot open to horizontal or above on rise with arms locked straight.
keyCoachingCues: Look at toes then spot bar
commonFaults: Resting hips on bar (turning it into a back hip circle)

videoTutorial.title: Clear Hip Circle on Uneven Bars | Level 4/5 Technique Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Squat-on / Pike-on to High Bar Jump
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Cast from low bar, place feet between hands on low bar in squat or pike, stand and jump to catch high bar.

steps: Cast from low bar, lift hips high above bar level with straight arms.
Place balls of feet softly on the low bar between or outside hands.
Stand up with chest rising and eyes spotting the high bar overhead.
Jump forward and upward to catch high bar in solid overgrip with straight arms.
keyCoachingCues: Catch high bar with straight arms
commonFaults: Bent arm catch on high bar

videoTutorial.title: Squat On and Jump to High Bar Tutorial | Uneven Bars

gapAnalysis.name: Tuck Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Tap swing on high bar, drive toes upward on front swing, release bar into tucked backward somersault and stick landing.

steps: Execute dynamic tap swings on high bar, creating high hollow-to-arch momentum.
On front swing, drive toes upward past horizontal toward ceiling.
Release the bar at 45° angle, pull knees tightly to chest in tucked somersault.
Spot landing mat, open tuck and stick firmly with arms in salute.
keyCoachingCues: Spot mat and open to stick
commonFaults: Releasing too late (flying straight up into bar)

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Flyaway on Bars | Progressive Drills & Safety

gapAnalysis.name: Back Walkover on Balance Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Lift lead leg, arch backward placing hands in line on beam, kick through 180° split and land in balanced lunge.

steps: Stand tall on beam with lead leg extended front and arms by ears.
Lift lead leg while arching backward through upper spine, eyes watching hands.
Place hands thumb-to-thumb on center line of beam with open shoulders.
Kick back foot up and through a full 180° split, stepping down softly in lunge.
prerequisites: Beam back walkover on low beam

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Back Walkover on Beam | Balance & Alignment

gapAnalysis.name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Acro Prep)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Sit in beam chair, jump backward with flight onto hands, step-out one foot at a time into confident lunge.

steps: Stand on beam with feet aligned, sit back as if into a chair with arms swinging.
Jump backward aggressively, extending through hips and driving arms by ears.
Place hands in line on beam, blocking through shoulders while splitting legs.
Step lead foot down along center line followed by back foot into secure lunge.
keyCoachingCues: Snap lead foot down on line
commonFaults: Short undercutting jump causing head crash
prerequisites: Floor back handspring step-out on line
Low beam back handspring with mats

videoTutorial.title: Back Handspring on Balance Beam Tutorial | Fear-Free Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Split Leap (120° Separation) on Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Running step or chassé into forward grand jeté on beam with minimum 120° split separation, sticking landing on line.

steps: Step smoothly along beam with upright core and confident vision.
Brush front foot forward aggressively while pushing through back ball of foot.
Reach a minimum 120° split at peak height with torso vertical.
Land on front foot in demi-plié along center line with trailing leg controlled.
commonFaults: Landing off center line of beam

videoTutorial.title: Mastering Split Leaps on Beam | Height, Split & Consistency

gapAnalysis.name: Full 1/1 Turn on One Foot on Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Single foot relevé turn completing 360° on beam with free leg in passé, finishing locked on beam line.

steps: Step forward onto supporting foot in deep plie, setting arms in first position.
Press into high relevé on ball of foot, snapping free foot into coupé or passé.
Spot far end of beam, whip head 360° and lock gaze back onto the beam.
Stop turn precisely on line with high relevé before lowering heel.
commonFaults: Wobbling off side of beam on stop

videoTutorial.title: Full Turn on Beam Tutorial | How to Stick Every Time

gapAnalysis.name: Front Tuck Dismount off Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Hurdle or step punch off end of beam into forward tucked somersault, opening to stick on landing mat.

steps: Approach end of beam with confident step-hurdle punch off balls of feet.
Drive arms and hips upward into a high forward somersault takeoff.
Tuck knees tightly to chest with hands grabbing shins.
Spot landing mat, open out of tuck and stick firmly in demi-plié.
keyCoachingCues: Punch off toes at end of beam
commonFaults: Slow opening causing deep squat or fall

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Front Tuck Dismount off Beam | Safe Progressions

gapAnalysis.name: Round-off Back Handspring Back Tuck (Salto)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Speed approach into round-off, connected back handspring, rebound punch into high backward tucked salto with stuck landing.

steps: Run with acceleration into a powerful round-off with aggressive snap down.
Immediately rebound into a fast, long back handspring, keeping arms by ears.
Punch both feet off floor through toes, driving chest and arms straight up into the air.
Pull knees to chest in a tight tuck, rotate 360°, open body and stick the landing.

videoTutorial.title: Round-Off Back Handspring Back Tuck Gymnastics Tutorial

gapAnalysis.name: Front Tuck (Punch Front Salto)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Short run into two-foot punch, soaring into high forward tucked somersault and landing upright with control.

steps: Run 3-4 steps with forward acceleration into a low, fast hurdle.
Punch both balls of feet simultaneously with arms lifting from hips past ears.
Lift hips high over head while tucking knees firmly into chest.
Spot floor on rotation, kick out of tuck and absorb landing with chest high.

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Punch Front (Front Tuck) | Floor Gymnastics

gapAnalysis.name: Switch Leap (120°+ Separation)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Swing lead leg forward to 45°, quickly scissor-switch legs in mid-air to reach minimum 120°-180° grand jeté split.

steps: Take a step-chassé preparation with upright posture.
Swing lead leg forward to approximately 45° with straight knee and pointed toe.
Aggressively switch legs in mid-air, driving front leg back and back leg forward.
Hit peak split of 120°+ before landing softly in demi-plié on front foot.
commonFaults: Swinging lead leg too high before switch

videoTutorial.title: Switch Leap Tutorial | How to Get a 180 Degree Switch Leap

gapAnalysis.name: Front Handspring Half-Off Vault (1/2 Twist Off)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Front handspring repulsion off vault table with 180° twist during post-flight, landing facing the vault table.

steps: Execute maximum speed run and punch springboard into strong pre-flight.
Block aggressively off table through shoulders in straight body alignment.
Initiate 1/2 twist from hips and core during post-flight after clearing table.
Spot the vault table and stick landing facing back toward the apparatus.
keyCoachingCues: Keep arms close to body on twist
commonFaults: Twisting on the table before blocking

videoTutorial.title: Front Handspring Half Off Vault Breakdown & Post-Flight Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Tsukahara Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Turn On)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Punch board, 1/4 to 1/2 turn cartwheel entry onto vault table, repelling backwards into high post-flight landing on feet.

steps: High-velocity run into aggressive springboard punch with arms driving up.
Turn 1/4 to 1/2 onto the table, placing first and second hand in cartwheel/round-off line.
Repel violently off the table through shoulders while snapping body straight.
Soar backward through air into solid upright landing on resi-mat.
keyCoachingCues: Square shoulders to table on contact
commonFaults: Turning too late off the board

videoTutorial.title: Tsukahara Vault Drills & Progressions | Platinum Gymnastics

gapAnalysis.name: Cast to Handstand (Vertical on Bars)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: From front support, cast with straight arms directly into a vertical handstand (within 10° of vertical) with ribs tucked.

steps: Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded upper back.
Lower slightly into hollow load and press down vigorously through palms.
Drive heels upward and open shoulders over hands into vertical handstand line.
Lock ribs, squeeze glutes, and hold vertical momentarily before returning or circling.

videoTutorial.title: How to Cast to Handstand on Uneven Bars | Pro Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Giant Circle (Back Giant on High Bar)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Full 360° rotation around high bar with straight arms and extended body line, passing through handstand.

steps: Cast to handstand on high bar, fall forward in long straight-body extension.
Pass under bar maintaining straight arms and tap heels through bottom.
On upswing, hollow chest and shift wrists over top of bar.
Kick heels through vertical handstand at apex and continue or prepare dismount.
keyCoachingCues: Stay long and straight on drop
commonFaults: Failing to shift wrists resulting in peel-off

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Giant Swing on Uneven Bars | Level 7 & Platinum

gapAnalysis.name: Layout Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: High tap swing on high bar, release into straight-body backward layout salto with zero knee bend and stick landing.

steps: Build momentum with high tap swing from giant circle or long hang cast.
At bottom of front swing, execute a sharp hollow tap driving heels upward.
Release bar as toes reach 45° above horizontal, holding body completely straight.
Spot the mat, absorb landing in solid stuck position with arms raised.
keyCoachingCues: Strong heel drive on front swing
Keep body locked like a board
commonFaults: Piking or tucking knees (downgrade to tuck flyaway)

videoTutorial.title: Layout Flyaway on Bars Tutorial | Perfect Technique & Safety

gapAnalysis.name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Flight Acro)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Sit back into beam flight jump backward, hands contacting center line with shoulder block, stepping out into confident lunge.

steps: Stand in tall aligned posture on beam, sit hips back in controlled hinge.
Drive through legs into backwards jump with arms sweeping past ears.
Block through palms on beam line while opening legs in split step-out.
Land first foot on center line, followed immediately by second foot in a locked lunge.
commonFaults: Flipping head back and missing line
prerequisites: Floor back handspring on straight line

videoTutorial.title: Back Handspring Step-Out on Beam | Fear Breakdown & Drills

gapAnalysis.name: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Forward lunge on beam, aggressive heel kick into no-handed cartwheel over beam, landing foot-foot in balanced lunge.

steps: Take a confident step into deep lunge on beam with chest driving forward.
Drive lead leg down into beam while kicking back leg with maximum velocity overhead.
Keep chest up and arms pulled into body or crown, rotating without hand support.
Spot beam center line on landing, stepping lead foot down followed by back foot.
commonFaults: Diving hands down toward beam in panic
prerequisites: Low beam aerial cartwheel with mats

videoTutorial.title: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam Tutorial | Drills & Confidence

gapAnalysis.name: Back Layout Dismount off Beam
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Round-off or punch off end of beam, soaring into straight-body back layout salto, sticking on landing mat.

steps: Hurdle into round-off off end of beam, blocking through hands on the wood.
Rebound backwards and upward with body held straight as an arrow.
Rotate through 360° layout somersault with arms by ears or crossed on chest.
Spot the landing mat, open chest and stick firmly in demi-plié.
keyCoachingCues: Straight body alignment (no tuck or pike)

videoTutorial.title: Back Layout Beam Dismount Tutorial | Level 7 & Platinum

gapAnalysis.name: Layout Salto (Floor Back Layout)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Round-off back handspring into maximum height punch, soaring through completely straight backward somersault to stick.

steps: Accelerate through a long hurdle into powerful round-off and back handspring.
Punch both balls of feet, driving arms straight overhead into high backward trajectory.
Maintain rigid hollow body line throughout entire 360° backward rotation.
Spot the floor, extend through ankles and stick landing cleanly with no steps.
keyCoachingCues: Hold body straight like a pencil
commonFaults: Bending knees (turning it into a back tuck)

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Back Layout on Floor | Gymnastics Tutorial

gapAnalysis.name: Back Layout 1/2 Twist (Floor)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Punch into back layout salto, initiating a 180° twist at the peak of the jump, and landing facing backwards.

steps: Execute powerful round-off back handspring into vertical punch.
Rise into layout position with arms overhead.
At apex of salto, wrap arms into chest and initiate 1/2 twist from hips.
Spot landing facing backwards, absorb impact in demi-plié and stick.
commonFaults: Twisting off the floor before lifting

videoTutorial.title: Back Layout Half Twist Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

gapAnalysis.name: Front Layout Salto (Punch Front Layout)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: High forward punch into straight-body front salto, rotating 360° forward without knee bend, sticking landing.

steps: Sprint forward into low, aggressive hurdle punch on balls of feet.
Drive arms and chest upward into high forward trajectory.
Maintain hollow body straight alignment as hips rotate forward over shoulders.
Spot floor on final descent, open body and stick landing softly.

videoTutorial.title: Front Layout Salto Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

gapAnalysis.name: Switch Leap to Tour Jeté Connection (Dance Series)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Switch leap (180° split) connected seamlessly without extra steps into a 1/2-turning tour jeté split leap.

steps: Perform switch leap with full 180° leg split and upright chest.
Land on ball of front foot in plie and immediately step into tour jeté preparation.
Jump and turn 180° in mid-air while switching legs into reverse grand jeté.
Land softly in arabesque or fondue with expressive posture.

videoTutorial.title: Switch Leap & Tour Jeté Dance Connections | Gymnastics Artistry

gapAnalysis.name: Double Turn (720° on One Foot on Floor)
gapAnalysis.shortDescription: Two full rotations (720°) on the ball of a single foot in high relevé with free leg in passé, finishing with control.

steps: Step forward into preparation lunge, arms centered in first position.
Push sharply into high relevé on single support leg, snapping free leg to knee passé.
Whip head around twice in rapid spotting action to complete 720° rotation.
Lock hips and core, checking out cleanly on relevé before lowering heel.

videoTutorial.title: How to Do a Double Turn in Gymnastics & Dance | 720 Degree Turn

fullCurriculum.name: Forward roll tuck
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level: Tucked chin, rounded spine roll to stand without hand push.

tutorial.title: How to Forward Roll | Gymnastics Tutorial

steps: Squat with knees together.
Tuck chin to chest.
Roll along spine.
Stand without hands pushing off floor.

fullCurriculum.name: Forward roll walkout
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level: Forward roll finishing in a continuous step-out / walkout into lunge.

tutorial.title: Forward Roll Step Out / Walkout Breakdown

steps: Roll forward smoothly with tucked head.
Step lead foot forward as hips pass over.
Walk out into balanced lunge.

fullCurriculum.name: Forward roll straddle
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level: Forward roll finishing in wide straddle stand with straight knees and pointed toes.

tutorial.title: Straddle Forward Roll Tutorial

steps: Roll forward along rounded back.
Open legs wide into straddle as heels touch.
Press hands between legs to push up to stand.

fullCurriculum.name: Bridge
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level: Back bridge hold with open shoulders, straight arms, and feet flat on floor.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Bridge with Open Shoulders

steps: Lie on back, place hands by ears with fingers toward shoulders.
Press through palms and feet to elevate hips.
Push shoulders over wrists and hold.

fullCurriculum.name: Straight jump and tuck jump
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level: Vertical straight jump immediately connected to explosive tuck jump with knees to chest.

tutorial.title: Straight Jump & Tuck Jump Gymnastics Drills

steps: Plie and jump into vertical straight jump.
Upon rebound, immediately pull knees into chest in tuck jump.
Stick landing in demi-plié.
keyCoachingCues: Knees to chest (not heels to butt)

fullCurriculum.name: Running tuck jump on the big mat stick it.
fullCurriculum.description: Gymfest Pre-Level Vault: Accelerated run, punch springboard, tuck jump onto mat stack and stick firmly.

tutorial.title: Running Punch Tuck Jump on Vault Mat

steps: Accelerated run down runway.
Low hurdle punch onto springboard.

Land softly in demi-plié with chest upright and stick without stepping.

fullCurriculum.name: Glide Kip on Low Bar
fullCurriculum.description: Piked glide forward, toes snap to bar at extension, dynamic hip drive pulling bar to waist into front support.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Kip on Uneven Bars | The Ultimate Coaching Guide

steps: Jump from mat into a long, powerful glide swing with legs straight and toes off floor.
Extend fully at forward peak, opening chest and hips into hollow body.
On backswing, pull toes rapidly to the bar while keeping arms straight.
Slide shins up the bar, shift wrists aggressively over bar and press tall into front support.
keyCoachingCues: Big open glide at the front
Toes to bar fast on return
commonFaults: Bending elbows when pulling toes up

fullCurriculum.name: Cast to Horizontal (Min Above 0°)
fullCurriculum.description: Dynamic heel drive from front support with shoulders over rail, elevating straight body line to horizontal (0°-15°).

tutorial.title: How to Cast to Horizontal and Handstand | Bars Drills

steps: Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded hollow upper body.
Load with a slight hip drop without bending elbows.
Press downward with palms while driving heels and toes upward past horizontal.
Hit horizontal line with toes pointed and return smoothly to bar.

fullCurriculum.name: Clear Hip Circle to Horizontal (Back Free Hip)
fullCurriculum.description: Cast away from bar, drop hips without touching rail, circle backward in hollow shape, open to horizontal.

tutorial.title: Clear Hip Circle on Uneven Bars | Level 4/5 Technique Drills

steps: Cast to horizontal, drop backward keeping straight arms pushing bar down.
Do not let hips rest on the bar; maintain hollow curve 2-4 inches off bar.
Rotate under bar and pull bar into hips momentarily, then push bar away.
Shoot open to horizontal or above on rise with arms locked straight.
keyCoachingCues: Look at toes then spot bar
commonFaults: Resting hips on bar (turning it into a back hip circle)

fullCurriculum.name: Squat-on / Pike-on to High Bar Jump
fullCurriculum.description: Cast from low bar, place balls of feet between hands on rail (squat or pike), stand and jump to catch high bar.

tutorial.title: Squat On and Jump to High Bar Tutorial | Uneven Bars

steps: Cast from low bar, lift hips high above bar level with straight arms.
Place balls of feet softly on the low bar between or outside hands.
Stand up with chest rising and eyes spotting the high bar overhead.
Jump forward and upward to catch high bar in solid overgrip with straight arms.
keyCoachingCues: Catch high bar with straight arms
commonFaults: Bent arm catch on high bar

fullCurriculum.name: Tuck Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
fullCurriculum.description: Tap swing on high bar, release at front apex, execute backward tucked salto rotation and stick landing.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Flyaway on Bars | Progressive Drills & Safety

steps: Execute dynamic tap swings on high bar, creating high hollow-to-arch momentum.
On front swing, drive toes upward past horizontal toward ceiling.
Release the bar at 45° angle, pull knees tightly to chest in tucked somersault.
Spot landing mat, open tuck and stick firmly with arms in salute.
keyCoachingCues: Spot mat and open to stick
commonFaults: Releasing too late (flying straight up into bar)

fullCurriculum.name: Cast to Handstand (Vertical on Bars)
fullCurriculum.description: Dynamic cast straight into 180° vertical handstand on high or low bar with zero hip angle deduction.

tutorial.title: How to Cast to Handstand on Uneven Bars | Pro Drills

steps: Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded upper back.
Lower slightly into hollow load and press down vigorously through palms.
Drive heels upward and open shoulders over hands into vertical handstand line.
Lock ribs, squeeze glutes, and hold vertical momentarily before returning or circling.

fullCurriculum.name: Giant Circle (Back Giant on High Bar)
fullCurriculum.description: 360° rotation around high bar with straight arms and body passing through vertical handstand at apex.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Giant Swing on Uneven Bars | Level 7 & Platinum

steps: Cast to handstand on high bar, fall forward in long straight-body extension.
Pass under bar maintaining straight arms and tap heels through bottom.
On upswing, hollow chest and shift wrists over top of bar.
Kick heels through vertical handstand at apex and continue or prepare dismount.
keyCoachingCues: Stay long and straight on drop
commonFaults: Failing to shift wrists resulting in peel-off

fullCurriculum.name: Layout Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
fullCurriculum.description: High bar swing with tap, release into stretched layout backward salto with stick landing.

tutorial.title: Layout Flyaway on Bars Tutorial | Perfect Technique & Safety

steps: Build momentum with high tap swing from giant circle or long hang cast.
At bottom of front swing, execute a sharp hollow tap driving heels upward.
Release bar as toes reach 45° above horizontal, holding body completely straight.
Spot the mat, absorb landing in solid stuck position with arms raised.
keyCoachingCues: Strong heel drive on front swing
Keep body locked like a board
commonFaults: Piking or tucking knees (downgrade to tuck flyaway)

fullCurriculum.name: Pak Salto Transition to Low Bar
fullCurriculum.description: Cast handstand on high bar, swing down and release into backward stretched salto between bars to catch low bar in hang.

tutorial.title: Pak Salto Progression on Bars

steps: Cast to handstand on high bar.
Swing forward, tap and release backward into layout salto.
Spot low bar rail during flight.
Catch low bar with arms straight and swing through.

fullCurriculum.name: Jump to Front Support Mount on Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Stand facing beam, jump placing both hands on surface, press into balanced front support with tall chest and pointed toes.

tutorial.title: Beam Mounts for Beginners & Silver Level

steps: Place hands flat on beam shoulder-width apart, fingers wrapping sides.
Punch springboard and push down through palms to elevate hips above beam.
Extend shoulders over hands in locked front support with legs glued together.
Swing right leg over beam into straddle or squat position with graceful posture.
keyCoachingCues: Eyes focused on far end of beam
prerequisites: Front support hold on floor bar

fullCurriculum.name: Arabesque Hold (30° Leg Lift)
fullCurriculum.description: Stand on one foot in releve or flat, lift rear leg straight to 30° minimum holding balance for 2 seconds with artistic arms.

tutorial.title: Arabesque & Balance Holds on Beam

steps: Stand tall with supporting leg locked.
Lift back leg smoothly with pointed toe.
Hold stationary for 2 seconds with chest lifted.
Lower with elegance to beam.

fullCurriculum.name: English Handstand Hold on Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Step into lunge, place hands side by side on beam, kick to 45° English handstand, tap toes together and step down.

tutorial.title: Handstand on Balance Beam | Progression & Safety

steps: Lunge on beam, arms by ears.
Reach hands to beam with thumbs on top, fingers gripping sides.
Kick to 45° with tight straight legs.
Step down one foot at a time into clean lunge.

fullCurriculum.name: Cross Handstand on Beam (Min 45° to Vertical)
fullCurriculum.description: Kick into handstand perpendicular or crosswise on beam, bringing legs together at minimum 45° angle to vertical with straight body alignment.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Handstand on Beam | Safe Drills & Confidence

steps: Start in deep beam lunge with arms by ears and torso aligned with front leg.
Reach far out, placing thumbs touching across the beam with fingers wrapped around sides.
Kick back leg up while levering body into a vertical or minimum 45° cross handstand.
Step down with dominant foot first into a clean beam lunge, arms finished in crown.
commonFaults: Crooked hand placement causing beam slip

fullCurriculum.name: Cartwheel on Balance Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Straight line cartwheel placing hands hand-over-hand along beam axis, kicking through vertical straddle to lunge.

tutorial.title: Cartwheel on Beam Tutorial | Step by Step Breakdown

steps: Stand in tall lunge on beam, sight the target spot 2 feet in front of toes.
Lever down placing lead hand turned inward, follow with second hand directly along center line.
Kick back leg strongly over top, passing through a vertical straddle plane with straight legs.
Land first foot on center line, immediately followed by second foot in a steady lunge.
keyCoachingCues: Keep shoulders in line of beam
commonFaults: Missing center line with second hand
Piking hips out of beam plane

fullCurriculum.name: Split Jump (60°-90° Split) on Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Explosive jump off two feet along beam axis, separating legs into equal 60°-90° split with stuck landing.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Split Jump on Beam | Tips for Balance & Height

steps: Stand with one foot slightly in front of the other, knees relaxed.
Plie through both feet and jump straight upward with arms swinging into side-middle or crown.
Split front and back leg simultaneously to at least 90° separation with pointed toes.
Pull legs together quickly on descent to land front-foot back-foot with soft knees.
commonFaults: Uneven leg split (front leg high, back leg low)

fullCurriculum.name: 1/2 Pivot Turn on One Foot (Beam)
fullCurriculum.description: Step into releve on one foot with other foot in passé, execute 180° rotation with tight core and upright carriage.

tutorial.title: Beam Pivot Turns Tutorial | Perfect Balance in Relevé

steps: Step forward onto the ball of one foot in high relevé, arms in first or fifth position.
Spot a focal point at opposite end of the beam to lock balance.
Turn head and shoulders 180° while pivoting cleanly on ball of foot.
Finish in locked relevé before lowering heel into preparation for next skill.

fullCurriculum.name: Round-off Dismount off End of Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Hurdle step along beam, place hands in T-position at beam end, snap legs together through vertical, rebound off end and stick.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Round Off Dismount on Beam

steps: Lunge along beam line approaching the dismount end with confident momentum.
Place hands in line near the end of the beam, kicking legs over with aggressive snap.
Push off beam with hands, snapping legs together before passing end of beam.
Land facing beam on landing mat, absorbing impact in demi-plié with arms presented.
keyCoachingCues: Drive the hurdle along center line
commonFaults: Looking down at hands and under-rotating

fullCurriculum.name: Back Walkover on Balance Beam
fullCurriculum.description: One-foot lifted bridge back along center line of beam, hands placed with thumbs together, kicking trailing leg smoothly over.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Back Walkover on Beam | Balance & Alignment

steps: Stand tall on beam with lead leg extended front and arms by ears.
Lift lead leg while arching backward through upper spine, eyes watching hands.
Place hands thumb-to-thumb on center line of beam with open shoulders.
Kick back foot up and through a full 180° split, stepping down softly in lunge.
prerequisites: Beam back walkover on low beam

fullCurriculum.name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Acro Prep)
fullCurriculum.description: Dynamic sit and jump backward along beam axis, hands contacting center line with flight, stepping out to lunge.

tutorial.title: Back Handspring on Balance Beam Tutorial | Fear-Free Drills

steps: Stand on beam with feet aligned, sit back as if into a chair with arms swinging.
Jump backward aggressively, extending through hips and driving arms by ears.
Place hands in line on beam, blocking through shoulders while splitting legs.
Step lead foot down along center line followed by back foot into secure lunge.
keyCoachingCues: Snap lead foot down on line
commonFaults: Short undercutting jump causing head crash
prerequisites: Floor back handspring step-out on line
Low beam back handspring with mats

fullCurriculum.name: Split Leap (120° Separation) on Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Forward step and elevation off one foot, splitting legs in air to minimum 120° with straight knees and upright chest.

tutorial.title: Mastering Split Leaps on Beam | Height, Split & Consistency

steps: Step smoothly along beam with upright core and confident vision.
Brush front foot forward aggressively while pushing through back ball of foot.
Reach a minimum 120° split at peak height with torso vertical.
Land on front foot in demi-plié along center line with trailing leg controlled.
commonFaults: Landing off center line of beam

fullCurriculum.name: Front Tuck Dismount off Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Hurdle or step forward toward end of beam, two-foot punch, forward tucked salto in air, sticking landing on 8" mat.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Front Tuck Dismount off Beam | Safe Progressions

steps: Approach end of beam with confident step-hurdle punch off balls of feet.
Drive arms and hips upward into a high forward somersault takeoff.
Tuck knees tightly to chest with hands grabbing shins.
Spot landing mat, open out of tuck and stick firmly in demi-plié.
keyCoachingCues: Punch off toes at end of beam
commonFaults: Slow opening causing deep squat or fall

fullCurriculum.name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Flight Acro)
fullCurriculum.description: Official flight acro requirement on balance beam: complete flight phase before hand contact, stepping out in rhythm.

tutorial.title: Back Handspring Step-Out on Beam | Fear Breakdown & Drills

steps: Stand in tall aligned posture on beam, sit hips back in controlled hinge.
Drive through legs into backwards jump with arms sweeping past ears.
Block through palms on beam line while opening legs in split step-out.
Land first foot on center line, followed immediately by second foot in a locked lunge.
commonFaults: Flipping head back and missing line
prerequisites: Floor back handspring on straight line

fullCurriculum.name: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam
fullCurriculum.description: No-handed cartwheel along beam axis: powerful hurdle punch, torso dip and heel kick through vertical, landing on beam.

tutorial.title: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam Tutorial | Drills & Confidence

steps: Take a confident step into deep lunge on beam with chest driving forward.
Drive lead leg down into beam while kicking back leg with maximum velocity overhead.
Keep chest up and arms pulled into body or crown, rotating without hand support.
Spot beam center line on landing, stepping lead foot down followed by back foot.
commonFaults: Diving hands down toward beam in panic
prerequisites: Low beam aerial cartwheel with mats

fullCurriculum.name: Back Layout Dismount off Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off off beam end into stretched backward layout salto in air, landing in stuck position on mat.

tutorial.title: Back Layout Beam Dismount Tutorial | Level 7 & Platinum

steps: Hurdle into round-off off end of beam, blocking through hands on the wood.
Rebound backwards and upward with body held straight as an arrow.
Rotate through 360° layout somersault with arms by ears or crossed on chest.
Spot the landing mat, open chest and stick firmly in demi-plié.
keyCoachingCues: Straight body alignment (no tuck or pike)

fullCurriculum.name: Back Handspring to Layout Step-out on Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Acro flight series: back handspring connected directly into stretched layout step-out without pause.
fullCurriculum.officialRef: USAG L9 Beam Acro Flight Series

tutorial.title: BHS to Layout Step-out Series on Beam

steps: Execute back handspring step-out along center line.
Rebound directly into backward layout jump without halting momentum.
Kick trailing leg through vertical layout step-out.
Step down into solid lunge balance.

fullCurriculum.name: Kick to Handstand Flatback on 16" Mat Stack
fullCurriculum.description: Take 3-4 steps, lunge onto floor, kick into vertical handstand with hands on edge of 16" mat stack, fall straight to flat back.

tutorial.title: Handstand Flatback Progression for Level 1 Vault

steps: Short accelerated approach into deep lunge.
Place hands on front edge of 16" mat.
Kick to vertical handstand with heels together.
Hollow and fall flat onto back with chin tucked.

fullCurriculum.name: Run & Hurdle to Flatback on 24" Mat Stack
fullCurriculum.description: Sprint 30-40ft, hurdle punch onto springboard, kick through handstand onto 24" mat stack, falling straight to flat back.

tutorial.title: Springboard to Handstand Flatback Vault Drills

steps: Run with forward acceleration.
Hurdle punch springboard with both feet simultaneously.
Reach hands to front edge of 24" mat stack.
Hit vertical and fall flat on back.

fullCurriculum.name: Handstand Flatback onto 32" Mat Stack
fullCurriculum.description: Accelerated board hurdle into tight handstand with heel drive, falling straight to flat back on 32" mat stack.

tutorial.title: Handstand Flat Back Vault Technique & Drills

steps: Run with forward acceleration and hurdle onto the springboard with feet together.
Punch board explosively, punching arms up through ears into 45° entry toward mat stack.
Hit vertical handstand momentarily on front edge of 32" mat stack.
Hollow down and drop flat onto back with chin tucked.
commonFaults: Arching through lower back on impact

fullCurriculum.name: Run & Hurdle onto Springboard to Straight Jump
fullCurriculum.description: Consistent accelerated sprint, low hurdle onto sweet spot of the board, and explosive vertical straight jump with stuck landing.

tutorial.title: How to Run and Hurdle onto the Springboard | Vault Drills

steps: Sprint 40-50 feet with upright sprinting mechanics and high knees, accelerating progressively.
Execute a low, forward-driven hurdle step off one foot without elevating excessively.
Punch both balls of feet simultaneously on the sweet spot (front third) of the springboard.
Drive arms straight up by ears, soaring into a tight hollow straight jump, and stick the landing on 8" mat.
commonFaults: Jumping too high into the board
prerequisites: Straight jump stick on floor line

fullCurriculum.name: Front Handspring over Vault Table
fullCurriculum.description: Official USAG Level 4-5 vault: accelerated run, punch springboard, pre-flight to table, shoulder block to post-flight and stick.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Front Handspring Vault | Technique Breakdown

steps: Sprint with maximum velocity down the 60-foot runway without stuttering.
Hurdle onto the springboard with arms driving backward to forward.
Hit board and punch into a straight pre-flight body angle of ~40° to the table.
Block explosively through shoulders on contact with the table and fly into stuck landing.
commonFaults: Piking or arching on the table

fullCurriculum.name: Half-On Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Twist Entry)
fullCurriculum.description: Hurdle onto board, initiate 1/4 to 1/2 twist in pre-flight, contact table in sideways handstand position, repel off to flatback/stand.

tutorial.title: Tsukahara & Half-On Vault Drills for Level 5 and Gold

steps: Hurdle onto springboard with rapid arm drive.
Punch board and initiate 1/4 to 1/2 turn from hips and core during pre-flight.
Place hands staggered/turned on table to repel off in sideways-to-backward alignment.
Land on feet or back onto mat stack with body rigid.
keyCoachingCues: Twist from the core, not arms
commonFaults: Twisting too early before leaving board

fullCurriculum.name: Front Handspring Half-Off Vault (1/2 Twist Off)
fullCurriculum.description: Front handspring entry onto vault table, explosive shoulder block, 1/2 twist in post-flight, landing facing the vault table.

tutorial.title: Front Handspring Half Off Vault Breakdown & Post-Flight Drills

steps: Execute maximum speed run and punch springboard into strong pre-flight.
Block aggressively off table through shoulders in straight body alignment.
Initiate 1/2 twist from hips and core during post-flight after clearing table.
Spot the vault table and stick landing facing back toward the apparatus.
keyCoachingCues: Keep arms close to body on twist
commonFaults: Twisting on the table before blocking

fullCurriculum.name: Tsukahara Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Turn On)
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off entry onto vault table with 1/2 turn on, explosive hand block into backward post-flight onto landing mat.

tutorial.title: Tsukahara Vault Drills & Progressions | Platinum Gymnastics

steps: High-velocity run into aggressive springboard punch with arms driving up.
Turn 1/4 to 1/2 onto the table, placing first and second hand in cartwheel/round-off line.
Repel violently off the table through shoulders while snapping body straight.
Soar backward through air into solid upright landing on resi-mat.
keyCoachingCues: Square shoulders to table on contact
commonFaults: Turning too late off the board

fullCurriculum.name: Tsukahara Piked / Layout Vault
fullCurriculum.description: 1/2 turn onto vault table followed by backward salto in piked or layout body shape with stuck landing.

tutorial.title: Tsukahara Layout Vault Breakdown

steps: Sprint at 9.0+ m/s down runway.
Punch springboard into 1/2 turn on.
Block explosively off table into stretched post-flight layout.
Rotate 360° backward, spot landing and stick.

fullCurriculum.name: Round-off Rebound Stick
fullCurriculum.description: Accelerated hurdle into round-off, snap legs together through vertical, violent block off hands and high hollow rebound stick.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Powerful Round-off on Floor | Rebound Drills

steps: Power hurdle with chest leaning into travel direction.
Place hands in T-shape on center floor line.
Kick legs up through vertical and snap together at 12 o’clock with 1/2 turn.
Repel off hands into high vertical rebound, sticking landing without bounce.

fullCurriculum.name: Split Leap (90° Separation) on Floor
fullCurriculum.description: Step into single-leg takeoff, elevate hips into equal 90° leg separation with straight knees and pointed toes, landing on front foot.

tutorial.title: How to Get Better Split Leaps | Drills for 180 and Height

steps: Take a continuous step or chassé with upright carriage and pointed feet.
Brush lead foot forward through low battement, exploding off trailing leg.
Achieve minimum 90° leg split at the peak of elevation with chest held tall.
Land softly in plie on front foot and step out with elegance.

fullCurriculum.name: Round-off Back Handspring Back Tuck (Salto)
fullCurriculum.description: Fundamental tumbling pass for Level 4-5 / Xcel Gold: round-off into rapid back handspring rebound, set high into backward tucked salto.

tutorial.title: Round-Off Back Handspring Back Tuck Gymnastics Tutorial

steps: Run with acceleration into a powerful round-off with aggressive snap down.
Immediately rebound into a fast, long back handspring, keeping arms by ears.
Punch both feet off floor through toes, driving chest and arms straight up into the air.
Pull knees to chest in a tight tuck, rotate 360°, open body and stick the landing.

fullCurriculum.name: Front Tuck (Punch Front Salto)
fullCurriculum.description: Forward running approach, two-foot punch into high vertical set, rotating forward tucked salto to stick landing.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Punch Front (Front Tuck) | Floor Gymnastics

steps: Run 3-4 steps with forward acceleration into a low, fast hurdle.
Punch both balls of feet simultaneously with arms lifting from hips past ears.
Lift hips high over head while tucking knees firmly into chest.
Spot floor on rotation, kick out of tuck and absorb landing with chest high.

fullCurriculum.name: Switch Leap (120°+ Separation)
fullCurriculum.description: Forward leg swings to 45°, reverses explosively backward while trailing leg swings forward, achieving 120°+ split at apex.

tutorial.title: Switch Leap Tutorial | How to Get a 180 Degree Switch Leap

steps: Take a step-chassé preparation with upright posture.
Swing lead leg forward to approximately 45° with straight knee and pointed toe.
Aggressively switch legs in mid-air, driving front leg back and back leg forward.
Hit peak split of 120°+ before landing softly in demi-plié on front foot.
commonFaults: Swinging lead leg too high before switch

fullCurriculum.name: Layout Salto (Floor Back Layout)
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off back handspring into explosive vertical takeoff, rotating backward in stretched hollow layout body line.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Back Layout on Floor | Gymnastics Tutorial

steps: Accelerate through a long hurdle into powerful round-off and back handspring.
Punch both balls of feet, driving arms straight overhead into high backward trajectory.
Maintain rigid hollow body line throughout entire 360° backward rotation.
Spot the floor, extend through ankles and stick landing cleanly with no steps.
keyCoachingCues: Hold body straight like a pencil
commonFaults: Bending knees (turning it into a back tuck)

fullCurriculum.name: Back Layout 1/2 Twist (Floor)
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off back handspring into high layout with 180° longitudinal twist initiated from high set, landing forward.

tutorial.title: Back Layout Half Twist Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

steps: Execute powerful round-off back handspring into vertical punch.
Rise into layout position with arms overhead.
At apex of salto, wrap arms into chest and initiate 1/2 twist from hips.
Spot landing facing backwards, absorb impact in demi-plié and stick.
commonFaults: Twisting off the floor before lifting

fullCurriculum.name: Switch Leap to Tour Jeté Connection (Dance Series)
fullCurriculum.description: Mandatory dance connection series: switch leap (180° split) connected in direct rhythm to 1/2 turning tour jeté leap.

tutorial.title: Switch Leap & Tour Jeté Dance Connections | Gymnastics Artistry

steps: Perform switch leap with full 180° leg split and upright chest.
Land on ball of front foot in plie and immediately step into tour jeté preparation.
Jump and turn 180° in mid-air while switching legs into reverse grand jeté.
Land softly in arabesque or fondue with expressive posture.

fullCurriculum.name: Double Turn (720° on One Foot on Floor)
fullCurriculum.description: High difficulty pirouette on floor: step into high releve, execute two full 360° rotations (720°) on one foot in passé.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Double Turn in Gymnastics & Dance | 720 Degree Turn

steps: Step forward into preparation lunge, arms centered in first position.
Push sharply into high relevé on single support leg, snapping free leg to knee passé.
Whip head around twice in rapid spotting action to complete 720° rotation.
Lock hips and core, checking out cleanly on relevé before lowering heel.

fullCurriculum.name: Double Back Tuck Salto
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off back handspring into explosive high set, completing two full backward tucked saltos before landing.

tutorial.title: Double Back Tuck Technique & Progressions

steps: High acceleration round-off into rapid back handspring.
Punch floor violently, driving chest and arms up to ceiling.
Pull knees tight into double tuck rotation.
Spot floor at 630°, open out of tuck and stick landing.
keyCoachingCues: Hold tight tuck through two flips

fullCurriculum.name: Blind Change (1/2 Pirouette on High Bar)
fullCurriculum.description: Cast to handstand on high bar, turn 180° on one arm into reverse grip swinging down smoothly into front giant.

tutorial.title: How to Do a Blind Change on Uneven Bars

steps: Cast to vertical handstand on high bar.
Shift weight onto turning hand while locking shoulder.
Release second hand and turn head and torso 180°.
Catch bar in underhand reverse grip at vertical and swing down into front giant.
keyCoachingCues: Shift weight cleanly onto single post arm

fullCurriculum.name: Back Handspring to Back Handspring Series
fullCurriculum.description: Mandatory acro flight series for Level 8: back handspring step-out connected with direct acceleration into second back handspring.

tutorial.title: Back Handspring to Back Handspring Beam Series

steps: Perform first back handspring step-out with straight hand alignment.
Upon lead foot contact, immediately rebound into second back handspring.
Keep vision locked on center line of beam.
Step down into solid finished lunge.
commonFaults: Hesitation or pause between handsprings (breaks connection)

fullCurriculum.name: Tsukahara Tucked Vault over Table
fullCurriculum.description: 1/2 turn onto vault table, violent hand block into backward tucked salto rotation landing firmly on 8" mat stack.

tutorial.title: Tsukahara Vault Tutorial & Drills

steps: Full sprint acceleration down runway into low board hurdle.
Turn 1/2 in pre-flight, contacting table in staggered hand placement.
Repel off table, pulling knees into chest in tight tuck.
Spot landing surface, open tuck, and stick landing.

fullCurriculum.name: Jaeger Salto Release (Straddle / Piked)
fullCurriculum.description: Front giant on high bar, tap and release over bar into forward tucked/straddled salto, catching bar in swing.

tutorial.title: Jaeger Release Bar Technique & Progressions

steps: Execute powerful front giant with undergrip on high bar.
Tap aggressively under bar, driving heels upward.
Release bar and flip forward in straddle salto over bar.
Catch bar in overgrip with arms extended and swing through.
keyCoachingCues: Reach and catch with locked wrists

fullCurriculum.name: Standing Full on Balance Beam
fullCurriculum.description: Standing backward salto with 360° twist (full twist) executed directly from beam surface with stuck landing.

tutorial.title: Standing Full on Beam Progression

steps: Stand on beam in plié with arms swinging back.
Explode vertically, setting chest and arms up to ceiling.
Wrap arms tightly to initiate 360° twist.
Spot beam at 270°, open body and stick landing on beam axis.

fullCurriculum.name: Yurchenko Full Twist (360° Layout)
fullCurriculum.description: Round-off onto board, back handspring onto table, block into high layout with 360° full twist in post-flight.

tutorial.title: Yurchenko Full Twist Technique Breakdown

steps: High-speed sprint into round-off hurdle onto springboard.
Back handspring contacts table before vertical.
Violent shoulder repulsion into soaring layout post-flight.
Wrap for 360° longitudinal twist, spot landing and stick.

fullCurriculum.name: Full-In Back-Out Salto (Double Salto with Full Twist)
fullCurriculum.description: High difficulty tumbling pass: round-off back handspring into double backward salto with full twist in first salto.

tutorial.title: Full-In Back-Out Salto Breakdown on Floor

steps: Maximum speed diagonal tumbling entry.
Punch floor vertically to ceiling with violent shoulder set.
Initiate full twist during first backward flip.
Complete second backward flip in tucked or layout shape, spot and stick.
commonFaults: Low set leading to dangerous landing
